declared.value: Reuse existing archive and rollback verification. The installed read-only planner must observe both layouts and exact version history on the versions' encoded date. Preserve M11 completion and the M12 readiness frontier.
debtChanges: Record owner authorization without treating it as a release receipt.
Use the installed planner instead of duplicating or bypassing calendar and mixed-layout policy.
Treat a successfully recorded BLOCKED verdict as a completed observation, not permission to publish either package.
declared.nextAction: If both previews match, qualify the supported publisher in a disposable feed using exact original bytes; otherwise retain the blocker and prepare an upstream coordination request or scoped deferral. Keep actual private mutation gated by the recorded owner conditions.
